## ProofService.processPresentation() method

Process a received [PresentationMessage](./core.presentationmessage.md). This will not accept the presentation or send a presentation acknowledgement. It will only update the existing proof record with the information from the presentation message. Use [ProofService.createAck()](./core.proofservice.createack.md) after calling this method to create a presentation acknowledgement.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processPresentation(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<PresentationMessage>): Promise<ProofRecord>;
```

| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| messageContext | [InboundMessageContext](./core.inboundmessagecontext.md)&lt;[PresentationMessage](./core.presentationmessage.md)&gt; | The message context containing a presentation message |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ProofRecord](./core.proofrecord.md)&gt;

proof record associated with the presentation message
